title: Contract-first design makes behaviour reviewable

items: Define amount, currency, payee and validation errors.
Specify replay scope, retention and conflicting-payload behaviour.
Keep resource creation distinct from payment completion.

elements.text: Illustrative contract excerpt. The idempotency policy still needs agreement and implementation.

notes:
APIOps introduction. Technical continuation is illustrative; no client implementation or measured improvement is claimed.

Illustrative operation and payload, not copied from a client contract or supplied by the scaffold. The starter scaffold contract uses OpenAPI 3.0.3 and a read-only Catalog example. OpenAPI describes operations, schemas, responses and security requirements; the service enforces the agreed behaviour. The proposed Idempotency-Key header represents an application contract decision.
